action.command: cd /workspace && grep -rn "API_PATH_PREFIX" pkg/config/*.go | head; echo "==="; (nohup ./badge-api serve --port 8080 > /tmp/serve3.log 2>&1 & echo $! > /tmp/badge.pid); for i in $(seq 1 25); do sleep 2; code=$(curl -s --max-time 3 -o /dev/null -w "%{http_code}" http://localhost:8080/api/v1/info 2>/dev/null); echo "t=$((i*2))s /api/v1/info=$code"; if [ "$code" = "200" ]; then break; fi; done; echo "=== info ==="; curl -s --max-time 5 http://localhost:8080/api/v1/info; echo; echo "=== metrics ==="; curl -s --max-time 5 -o /dev/null -w "metrics=%{http_code}\n" http://localhost:8080/metrics

tool_call.name: terminal
tool_call.arguments: {"command": "cd /workspace && grep -rn \"API_PATH_PREFIX\" pkg/config/*.go | head; echo \"===\"; (nohup ./badge-api serve --port 8080 > /tmp/serve3.log 2>&1 & echo $! > /tmp/badge.pid); for i in $(seq 1 25); do sleep 2; code=$(curl -s --max-time 3 -o /dev/null -w \"%{http_code}\" http://localhost:8080/api/v1/info 2>/dev/null); echo \"t=$((i*2))s /api/v1/info=$code\"; if [ \"$code\" = \"200\" ]; then break; fi; done; echo \"=== info ===\"; curl -s --max-time 5 http://localhost:8080/api/v1/info; echo; echo \"=== metrics ===\"; curl -s --max-time 5 -o /dev/null -w \"metrics=%{http_code}\\n\" http://localhost:8080/metrics", "security_risk": "MEDIUM", "summary": "Probe /api/v1/info and /metrics endpoints"}
